tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream by day (paper, diary feel), deep night by night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Composer, sheets, menus, neutral win cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and input borders. Decorative only, never the sole affordance.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on surface, surface-raised, every card tint, glow and sage. Softer than black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Usernames, timestamps, helper text. 4.5:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The brand colour: a win's light. Primary button fill (ink text on it), the glow when a win is posted, the active celebrate state. Use once per view as the main action.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on glow (primary buttons, the Celebrated pill). Dark ink in both themes, because Night's ink is light and would fail contrast on honey.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Firefly dots, the halo behind a posted win, progress in the jar. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: glow-ink
tokens.usage: Honey-coloured text and icons on surface (links, 'You celebrated this'). 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: The night the jar glows in: app icon ground, letters-to-future-self envelopes, the Hard Day screen. White or cream text on it.

tokens.name: on-dusk
tokens.usage: Text and icons on dusk. 9:1+.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Growth and rest: success toasts, the private-win badge fill, streak calendar days. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Green text/icons on surface, e.g. 'Saved privately'.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Celebration burst particles and the reaction pop only. Never for errors, never for text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (delete win, report) and form errors. Rare; this app should almost never look alarmed.

tokens.name: card-peach
tokens.usage: Win card tint for Social wins. Ink text.

tokens.name: card-butter
tokens.usage: Win card tint for Work and study wins. Ink text.

tokens.name: card-mint
tokens.usage: Win card tint for Health and body wins. Ink text.

tokens.name: card-sky
tokens.usage: Win card tint for Mind and calm wins. Ink text.

tokens.name: card-lilac
tokens.usage: Win card tint for Learning and creative wins. Ink text.

tokens.name: card-blush
tokens.usage: Win card tint for Self-care wins. Ink text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px surface gap. 3:1+ against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between reaction chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside small controls and between chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of small controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Masonry gap between win cards at every width.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Win card padding. Generous padding is what makes text-only cards feel calm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing; page side margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Win cards, sheets, the composer. Soft corners read as safe and friendly.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Reaction chips, category tags, the floating Add win button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Win cards at rest. Barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card on hover/press and the composer sheet.
